spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact spec surface (renderSizeHint option + BaseAudioContext.renderQuantumSize) and explicitly demonstrates the ignored-unknown-dictionary-member trap the anti-regression rules forbid falling into.

interactive.rationale: One button performs the real construction with the hint plus all three probes; four live cells and a status explain the verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the trap demonstration plus honest probes; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles feature-absent (undefined read), hint-adjusted (UA rounding allowed by spec), and hint-honoured verdicts distinctly.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5078190552907776 plus both spec anchors and MDN.

conformance.rationale: Suite asserts the prototype member, default 128, integer-hint effect, hardware keyword, worklet agreement, and — as its own assertion — the constructor-never-throws trap.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: construction 'succeeded' (trap shown), prototype false, value undefined, verdict feature-absent; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: Amber for the trap's deceptive success, emerald/rose for honest verdicts (AA on paper); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Native button; status aria-live; labelled probe cells.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Probe grid collapses under 640px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Verify hint-honoured verdict on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On a supporting engine the cells should read succeeded/true/256/hint-honoured. Re-run then.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout updates aria-live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce probe outcomes via live regions.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive probe grid small screens no overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single-column collapse below a min width.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the ignored-dictionary trap and the honest feature-absent verdict both demonstrated live on Chromium 141 with a clean console at both viewports.
